company.what_they_do: Marijuana Medical Clinic (MMC Florida) is a Florida-based medical marijuana card provider offering telehealth-first evaluations and certifications. They connect patients with state-licensed physicians who can certify them for a Florida medical marijuana card. The process is designed to be fast and simple: patients schedule a telehealth appointment with an MMJ doctor, complete online intake forms, and upload proof of condition and a driver's license photo. Their key differentiators are same-day approval (most patients receive approval within 4 hours of submitting their state application), flat transparent pricing ($149 for a full 7-month certification; $129 for recertifications), a 100% money-back guarantee if not approved, acceptance of FSA and HSA payment, and same-day telehealth renewals. They also donate a portion of profits to charitable organizations, positioning themselves as locally rooted and community-minded.
